label: Test contingent-foundation exemptions under parity and determining explanation
summary:
See docs/notes/psr-self-application-756.md#does-a-contingent-foundation-merit-exemption-from-determining-explanation-2026-11-23. Distinguishes actual adequate existential reasons (E) for contingent concrete individuals, determining reasons (D) and a stance's demand. Each negation requires an actual counterinstance at its own standard. The existing parity results concern some reason. In the analyst extension, uniformity transfers a determining demand to the accepted fact. Honoring it yields an explaining fact with the required modal sufficiency in the picture. Its absence there contradicts the premises. The stance can mistakenly believe it absent. Factivity and explanatory adequacy are further conditions. Changing which individual fills a role can leave n present as a dependent. Failure of a proposed basis to determine n's existence requires an accessible absence of the same n with the entire basis holding. A complete initial inventory and production rule can exclude a further newly appearing brute agent within their warranted scope. An additional basic agent outside the proposed inventory tests that scope. A change of the initial inventory tests which inventory obtains. Evidence for a restriction, the restriction's actual governance and the existence of its concrete bearer are distinct. LawActuality.omissions preserves mathematical uniqueness with no state-bearers present. A contingent structure can explain a restriction that follows from its nature while leaving its own instantiation open. A derivative-only rival may take a constrained order as primitive. Apply the same requirements to personal and impersonal sources. Actual nonnecessitating production can explain the product while leaving a contrast about the exercise open. The #755 collapse core requires additional premises beyond D. Moderate provisional preference for E over a brute exception, suspension about universal D. Token coverage and BX1/BX2 give B2. In firstMoverNecessaryByEsseCause the mover exists at w by B0. B3 gives its hypothetical distinct esse-cause simple priority and B1 excludes that distinct predecessor. The unprioritized control retains B2 and a contingent first mover without B3.

2026-11-24 actual-exercise continuation: the earlier fixed-act checkpoint remains accepted-qualified and published in PR-1933 at 2648404f2213921de852b8c4ff94359825a6ed4c. New three-certificate cluster in ActualExerciseExplanation reuses the joint-supply trap on the SAME source, adoption role and recipient. Source AND product supplying adoption plus adoption supplying product obstructs Supply only when every actual alternative retains that dependence and neither role is independently supplied. The necessary source, nonempty actual contribution paths, path-credit existential-token coverage and B2 are present in all three matched profiles. Merely admitting a direct source route does not restore actual supply; exercising it does. A direct source-to-product bypass restores supply while preserving product-dependent adoption, so output dependence alone does not establish the obstruction. A primitive direct-exercise seed also restores supply without another event or bearer. Actual Supply is not scenario sufficiency. Horizontal inspection of WholePowerPerfection and IntentionalExemplarExtension found actual same-bearer self/effect cognition under open bridges, but no inference to operative practical adoption of this D; the helpers are unregistered at this baseline. Full types, warrant, strongest impersonal rival and intrinsic-orientation objection are in docs/notes/psr-self-application-756.md#actual-productive-exercise-and-the-output-dependence-test-2026-11-24.

Integration refresh at main 72b65088093c6c237f148bc7319a475ee4619c56: merged #1941 supplies the conditional same-source actual-exercise bridge oneIntellectualPowerGivesWilledGiving (b5b84276), and its withholding-holder application (963e9689). Given source intellect, one power, will following intellect, will as a rational power and giving as own-power exercise, the actual giving exercises that source's rational power. This is stronger than a merely available cognitive capacity, but the types contain no practical content D or its directive role. Controls ec6627bf show DNP_inv is classically exactly no CHANCE_3 at invariant sources, and show a one-power CHANCE_3 source cannot retain intellect under the will bridges. Independent intellect evidence therefore bears on the rival, while DNP_inv is no additional independent warrant. The matched comparison types no contrastive explanation or good-directed-order discriminator. The frozen actual-exercise certificates are unchanged; reuse these new-main results instead of duplicating them.

2026-11-24, #1957 source-specification/esse promotion: exact reuse found the act-identity/constitutive-ground/transport test and structural controls already in causal-perfection-transfer.md. No repeated matrix or cycle theorem is added. Same-target, same-relation identity substitution is valid; a model independently toggling act-ground transport is not a counterexample to equality substitution. The live classification is whether product dependence concerns the very intrinsic actuality identified with esse or a relational fact about its directed exercise. Read complete pinned ST I q.45 a.3, q.13 a.7, q.19 a.2/a.3/a.5 and Spinoza Ethics I proposition 33 with both notes. The relational source account distinguishes subject-to-relation from principle-to-creature priority, while q.13 a.7 ad 3 prevents treating the Creator-denomination analogy as a completed account of immanent D-directed willing. The reviewed unmerged PR-1933 cut, matched comparison and output bypass remain candidate-branch evidence; the bypass tests all-route productive dependence, not literal act/esse identity or strong simplicity. Reused merged OneDependenceOrder/DependenceOrderSenses and actualGroundingAsymmetricOfWF, retaining actual concrete endpoints and explicit causal/grounding inclusion. Reconciled the existing #1944 holder-to-GOD_4 will consumer and #1947 conditional NAR support without assigning either a practical-content or esse-grounding conclusion. Preserve direct exercise and primitive/cumulative warrant symmetrically for personal and impersonal sources. See docs/notes/psr-self-application-756.md#source-specification-and-existential-grounding-1957-2026-11-24.

#2103 coverage audit at 632e76a81. (a) Existence reasons for each actual contingent (608a262d), non-self-explanation BX1 and attribution of esse-cause to the reason's source BX2 give B2 (8a8d00e9) by BruteContingencyParity.esseCauseFromExistenceReasons (7bf9cb77, argument a8823bd2). FirstMoverNecessity.firstMoverNecessaryByEsseCause (8cc169e3, argument 3f81c1b0) takes explicit excluded middle on the mover's existence at each accessible world, existence of a first unmoved mover, actual existence of movers at w, firstness (no simply prior being), pure actuality of first unmoved movers, B2 and B3 (a distinct esse-cause is simply prior). Of its same-witness conclusion, necessity of existence across accessible worlds is derived from excluded middle, B2, B3 and firstness; pure actuality is supplied directly by its own premise, not derived. The reason, CAUSE_2 and contingency definitions remain linked on the respective statements. Parity (6e7f5afd) concerns uniform demand and acceptance of a brute exception under one standard. (e) To promote that demand to a determining reason, establish factivity and modal sufficiency of the whole basis for the same token. Neither parity nor relocation of a role supplies those premises.

(a) NoFoundationLawChaos.certificate (6e3bad3f, argument 50ff5c59) uses spliced tails at one record prefix. Suffix completeness yields no uniform record-only forecast and excludes a deterministic universal projection. recombinationFork (765d8679) separates finite closure from whole suffix completeness; omissions (9d9c1993) retain bounded alternatives and a stable profile. ContainedSelection.restrictionBoundary (9a2c5f49) separates a restricting condition from a selector or existence explanation. ActualExerciseExplanation.productiveCut, matchedComparison and outputBypass (08c4864c, 07a1a262, 83d0e838) use actual joint productive supply with fixed source, adoption and recipient. A merely available route cannot rescue the cut; actual direct exercise or actual output bypass can. (e) To apply these boundaries to bare foundationlessness, exhibit admissible disagreeing tails at one fixed record and explain the proposed closure, or supply an independently warranted restricting mechanism. Brute contingency of an input alone supplies neither unrestricted recombination nor loss of knowledge. ReadingSelfCertification.certificate (b16198d5) and the admitted same-record controls test warrant and record discriminability at their own scope; the EAAN application e519065f remains a distinct open question.

(c) Actual grounding asymmetry for actual concreta follows from the compiled well-foundedness theorem actualGroundingAsymmetricOfWF, which has no dedicated result record. ActualExerciseExplanation.outputBypass is a supply control, independent of literal act/esse identity. EssenceActFactInvariance.fixedBearerControls (cdda0f09, argument c1613f21) transports predicates across equal extensions only under an exact extension criterion and gives a fixed-bearer model without that criterion. (e) For the #1957 promotion to existential dependence, first establish that the effect grounds the intrinsic actuality literally identified with the source's esse and calibrate both terms in the same actual-grounding order. A relational specification or a coextensive description alone does not meet that test. The next application fixes the act, source and recipient and asks whether the recipient supplies that actuality or enters as the term of its exercise. Existing B2 and source-independence consumers retain their direct-assumption options.
blocker: Actual production and receipt support E for produced and received beings. Extension to an underived simple individual, adequacy-to-token and concrete-scope bridges remain open, as do warranted scope and actuality of a proposed global inventory constraint. The fixed-act deletion and productive-supply tests are delivered by the integrated #1933 dependency. Its conditional rational-power exercise and matched supply controls retain their original scope. The #1957 promotion question is now classified: genuine dependence of the intrinsic act transfers with real act/esse identity in the same relation, whereas relational specification dependence does not yet have that target. The remaining metaphysical blocker is an account of what makes the same source's apprehended D actually operative in this production, deciding whether the product constitutes the intrinsic actuality or only enters a completed relation. Existing cut/asymmetry results apply once the appropriate dependence, all-route, identity and actual-grounding calibrations are warranted. No new root premise is discharged; no further decision event or first-order existence-token obligation follows merely from a role fact.

current_assessment.scope: Product-dependent operative specification and promotion to the same simple source's esse (#1957)
current_assessment.assessment: The positive identity argument has force for genuine dependence of the very intrinsic actuality identified with esse; no objection to same-target, same-relation substitution was identified. Applying it merely to a product-dependent relational fact changes the explanatory target. The source-supported distinction between subject-to-relation and principle-to-creature priority favors the relational reply against promotion from effect-relative denomination alone. It does not establish that actual D-directed willing has this relational realization. Existing transport toggles and the PR-1933 output bypass are structural controls with different scopes, not countermodels to literal equality or full strong simplicity. Actual roothood or calibrated same-relation asymmetry, rather than necessary existence alone, excludes the incoming ground. Personal and impersonal direct exercise retain the same primitive and cumulative-warrant options, while independent intellect/will evidence remains consequential. Retain the earlier moderate preference for E, suspension about universal D and B2/C2 boundaries; no personal-over-impersonal ranking or new root discharge follows.
current_assessment.next_test: For fixed n, D and x, identify the positive reality making D operative and its actual explanatory direction: does x supply or constitute the source's intrinsic actuality, or only enter the completed relation whose productive principle is independently actual? A defended first reading activates existing identity/calibration and asymmetry; a defended second reading must preserve actual apprehension, nondeviant practical direction and independently stated fulfillment conditions. The practical-relation work is already selected in #1953/#1737. Reopen #1957 on that classification, not another transport matrix, two-cycle proof or output-conformity table. Reuse the complete existing holder/root/will bundles and the equally applicable impersonal direct-exercise option.
